title: List every line not in the source
statement: Generate from the content itself a list of every learner-facing line that is not word for word from the approved source, so each can be approved, rewritten or cut.
example: One such generated list held 480 of a 3D version's own student-facing lines.
detail: A 3D version keeps its approved source's words verbatim and writes, from its own code, a file of every student-facing sentence that is not word for word from the source, grouped by file, so the builders' lines can be approved or rewritten in one pass; the file says it is generated and must not be edited by hand, and it counts 480 lines. A separate fidelity gate fails any quoted run of two or more words in the code that does not appear in the sources.
against: The list leaves out judge-only strings such as expected answers and rubrics, and any line under four words (`othello-archive/scripts/drafts.mjs`, lines 5 and 13), so the marking criteria never go for approval, and its staleness check is not yet part of the build's main check (the same file, line 4).
